{
	"name": "eslint-plugin-unicorn",
	"version": "79.0.0",
	"description": "More than 300 powerful ESLint rules",
	"license": "MIT",
	"repository": "github:sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn",
	"funding": "https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn?sponsor=1",
	"author": "Sindre Sorhus <sindresorhus@gmail.com> (https://sindresorhus.com)",
	"type": "module",
	"exports": {
		"types": "./index.d.ts",
		"default": "./index.js"
	},
	"sideEffects": false,
	"engines": {
		"node": ">=22"
	},
	"scripts": {
		"coverage": "node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=index.js --test-coverage-include=\"configs/**\" --test-coverage-include=\"rules/**\" --test-coverage-exclude=\"test/**\" test/*.js test/unit/*.js",
		"create-rule": "node ./scripts/create-rule.js && npm run create-rules-index-file && npm run fix:eslint-docs",
		"create-rules-index-file": "node ./scripts/create-rules-index-file.js",
		"fix": "run-p --continue-on-error \"fix:*\"",
		"fix:eslint-docs": "eslint-doc-generator",
		"fix:js": "npm run lint:js -- --fix",
		"fix:markdown": "npm run lint:markdown -- --fix",
		"fix:non-js-languages": "node ./scripts/create-non-js-languages-list.js",
		"fix:snapshots": "node --test --test-update-snapshots test/*.js test/unit/*.js",
		"integration": "node ./test/integration/test.js",
		"lint": "run-p --continue-on-error \"lint:*\"",
		"lint:eslint-docs": "npm run fix:eslint-docs -- --check",
		"lint:js": "eslint",
		"lint:markdown": "markdownlint \"**/*.md\"",
		"lint:non-js-languages": "node ./scripts/create-non-js-languages-list.js --check",
		"lint:package-json": "eslint \"**/package.json\"",
		"rename-rule": "node ./scripts/rename-rule.js && npm run create-rules-index-file && npm run fix:eslint-docs",
		"run-rules-on-codebase": "eslint --config=./eslint.dogfooding.config.js",
		"smoke": "eslint-remote-tester --config ./test/smoke/eslint-remote-tester.config.js",
		"test": "npm-run-all --node-run --continue-on-error lint \"test:*\"",
		"test:js": "node --test test/*.js test/unit/*.js"
	},
	"files": [
		"index.js",
		"index.d.ts",
		"configs",
		"rules"
	],
	"keywords": [
		"eslint",
		"eslintplugin",
		"eslint-plugin",
		"unicorn",
		"linter",
		"lint",
		"style",
		"xo"
	],
	"dependencies": {
		"@eslint-community/eslint-utils": "^4.10.1",
		"@eslint/css-tree": "^4.1.1",
		"browserslist": "^4.29.1",
		"change-case": "^5.4.4",
		"ci-info": "^4.4.0",
		"core-js-compat": "^3.50.0",
		"detect-indent": "^7.0.2",
		"entities": "^8.1.0",
		"find-up-simple": "^1.0.1",
		"globals": "^17.12.0",
		"identifier-regex": "^1.1.0",
		"indent-string": "^5.0.0",
		"is-builtin-module": "^5.0.0",
		"micromark": "^4.0.3",
		"parse5": "^8.0.1",
		"pluralize": "^8.0.0",
		"quote-js-string": "^0.1.0",
		"regjsparser": "^0.13.3",
		"reserved-identifiers": "^1.2.0",
		"semver": "^7.8.5",
		"strip-indent": "^4.1.1",
		"yaml": "^2.9.1"
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"@babel/code-frame": "^8.0.6",
		"@eslint/css": "^2.0.0",
		"@eslint/eslintrc": "^3.3.7",
		"@eslint/json": "^2.1.0",
		"@eslint/markdown": "^8.0.3",
		"@html-eslint/eslint-plugin": "^0.66.1",
		"@html-eslint/parser": "^0.66.1",
		"@lubien/fixture-beta-package": "^1.0.0-beta.1",
		"@typescript-eslint/parser": "^8.70.1",
		"@typescript-eslint/types": "^8.70.1",
		"enquirer": "^2.4.1",
		"eslint": "^10.11.0",
		"eslint-config-xo": "^4.0.1",
		"eslint-doc-generator": "^3.7.1",
		"eslint-package-json": "^1.0.0",
		"eslint-plugin-eslint-plugin": "^7.6.2",
		"eslint-plugin-jsdoc": "^64.5.4",
		"eslint-plugin-toml": "^1.5.0",
		"eslint-plugin-unicorn": "^73.0.0",
		"eslint-plugin-yml": "^3.8.1",
		"eslint-remote-tester": "^4.0.4",
		"eslint-remote-tester-repositories": "^2.0.2",
		"eslint-scope": "^9.1.2",
		"eslint-soml": "^0.0.4",
		"espree": "^11.2.0",
		"listr2": "^11.1.0",
		"markdownlint-cli": "^0.49.1",
		"nano-spawn": "^2.1.0",
		"node-style-text": "^2.1.2",
		"npm-run-all2": "^9.0.3",
		"open-editor": "^6.0.0",
		"outdent": "^0.8.0",
		"pretty-ms": "^9.3.1",
		"svelte": "^5.57.1",
		"svelte-eslint-parser": "^1.8.1",
		"typescript": "^6.0.3",
		"vue-eslint-parser": "^10.4.1"
	},
	"peerDependencies": {
		"eslint": ">=10.4",
		"typescript": "*"
	},
	"peerDependenciesMeta": {
		"typescript": {
			"optional": true
		}
	}
}
